text:
mike_finance: Heads-up: Finance wants to run a pricing experiment for hosted token rates and committed-discount offers. Goal: measure revenue uplift vs churn and conversion. Need ops + product + sales signoff and rollout plan.
rachel_product: Can you summarize the arms? also include expected sample size and duration.
mike_finance: Two arms + holdout: A = 15% discount for customers who opt into 3-month commitment (promo_code COMMIT15). B = usage-credit model: 10% extra free tokens added to invoice as credit each month (credit shows as line item). Holdout = no change. Target run: 6 weeks. Sample: 20% treatment (split A/B equally), 10% holdout, rest control.
jorge_sales: Sales note: commitments should not modify contract language for enterprise deals. Exclude any customer with custom billing or signed SOW. Also need a go-to-market email template for small/mid customers.
tina_ops: Ops checklist: 1) load promo codes into billing: POST /promo_codes 2) add metadata.pricing_experiment_cohort on customer record 3) ensure invoices show "Promo credit: COMMIT15" or "Usage credit" line correctly 4) sandbox smoke on billing + accounting exports. @billing-bot can we create promo via api?
billing-bot: automation: promo creation supported. Endpoint: POST /promos with body {"code":"COMMIT15","type":"discount","pct":15,"expires":"2025-01-01"}. Also supports per-subscription metadata and invoice_line_label override. Docs: https://billing.internal/docs/promos
mike_finance: CSV for new price sheet (for upload):
```plan,segment,old_price_per_1k,new_price_per_1k,notes
hosted-gen,small,0.35,0.35,control
hosted-gen,mid,0.28,0.238,treatment-A 15% commit
hosted-gen,mid,0.28,0.28,control
hosted-embed,all,0.06,0.066,treatment-B usage credit
```
rachel_product: For experiment signals: primary metric = net revenue per customer cohort; secondary: 30-day churn, and trial->paid conversion. Stop criteria: if churn in any treatment cohort > 2x baseline or if we see >5% negative revenue delta vs control after 2 weeks.
jorge_sales: Communication: we'll prepare an FAQ. Also request an "opt-in via sales" flow for larger customers so they can commit on calls.
tina_ops: Exemptions to auto-enrollment: enterprise contracts (contract_type != 'standard'), active legal reviews, and customers flagged by account teams. We'll add a tag "pricing_exempt".
mike_finance: Good. Who approves sending promo to production? Product + Sales + Legal + Ops. Can we get quick reactions?
rachel_product: +1 from product. Need monitoring dashboard: cohort breakdown, ARR impact, refund rate, invoice disputes. I'll coordinate with analytics.
jorge_sales: +1 from sales. Will draft email template and A/B subject lines for open rate testing.
legal-bot: auto msg: legal requires promo terms on website + updated MSA clause referencing promotional credits and commitments. I'll loop in @legal.
tina_ops: +1 from ops. Sandbox test scheduled tomorrow 9:30am PT. I'll run end-to-end with 3 customers in sandbox and export reports.
mike_finance: Note on grandfathering: existing paid customers who are on active billing should not be auto-enrolled; but customers on standard free-tier can be part of experiment. For customers that explicitly ask to be grandfathered, set metadata.grandfather_until = "2026-01-01".
rachel_product: Also add a "customer-facing" FAQ snippet explaining billing line items and how credits appear. We'll attach to the support KB.
jorge_sales: For renewals >$200k, automatic exclusion. I'll send account list to ops.
tina_ops: Billing job run: price-sheet-import task queued at 1720001500 in staging. job id staging_4421.
mike_finance: Final note: post-rollout plan includes rollback procedures: set promo codes inactive, revert price-sheet CSV, set grandfather metadata for opted-out customers, and process manual refunds if misbilled.
rachel_product: I'll own dashboards and stop criteria enforcement. Please tag all monitoring alerts to #incidents if thresholds hit.
jorge_sales: We'll prepare customer comms and sales playbook.
tina_ops: Will update invoice templates to include "Promo credit" label and test accounting export.
mike_finance: Thanks team. If no objections by EOD, we'll move promos to prod on Mon and start the first small cohort. Will post PR + promo IDs here. :rocket:
